tools.name: list_print_qa_services
tools.description: Free catalog of seven print and vector QA APIs: prices, inputs, limits and sample URLs. No payment.

tools.name: get_print_qa_sample
tools.description: Free built-in sample report for one service. Does not analyze your artwork and never pays.

tools.name: prepare_preflight
tools.description: Find artwork risks before sending SVG to print. Prepare a paid HTTP request (0.02 USDC on Base). This MCP tool does not perform analysis, sign or charge. Returns the canonical endpoint, supplied input and payment instructions. Flags raster, live text, RGB, effects and open-path candidates. Heuristic

tools.name: prepare_printcheck
tools.description: Check whether sampled details are too fine for a printing method. Prepare a paid HTTP request (0.05 USDC on Base). This MCP tool does not perform analysis, sign or charge. Returns the canonical endpoint, supplied input and payment instructions. Measures sampled ink geometry. Not a PDF/CDR importer.

tools.name: prepare_curve_clearance
tools.description: Measure the gap between two curves before engraving or printing. Prepare a paid HTTP request (0.03 USDC on Base). This MCP tool does not perform analysis, sign or charge. Returns the canonical endpoint, supplied input and payment instructions. Returns witness points and a conservative bound; check c

tools.name: prepare_small_features
tools.description: Find tiny polygon objects and holes before production. Prepare a paid HTTP request (0.03 USDC on Base). This MCP tool does not perform analysis, sign or charge. Returns the canonical endpoint, supplied input and payment instructions. Checks object and hole dimensions; no SVG or curve import.

tools.name: prepare_vector_health
tools.description: Find duplicate nodes and short edges in prepared vector paths. Prepare a paid HTTP request (0.05 USDC on Base). This MCP tool does not perform analysis, sign or charge. Returns the canonical endpoint, supplied input and payment instructions. Checks explicit polylines, not unconverted curved artwork.

tools.name: prepare_cutting_paths
tools.description: Find open contours and self-intersections before cutting. Prepare a paid HTTP request (0.05 USDC on Base). This MCP tool does not perform analysis, sign or charge. Returns the canonical endpoint, supplied input and payment instructions. Reports topology risks; not CNC certification.

tools.name: prepare_native_vector_health
tools.description: Inspect original SVG or restricted CorelDRAW EPS curve commands. Prepare a paid HTTP request (0.08 USDC on Base). This MCP tool does not perform analysis, sign or charge. Returns the canonical endpoint, supplied input and payment instructions. Preserves native curves; rejects unsupported constructs

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_print_qa_services · Public sink: prepare_preflight, prepare_printcheck, prepare_curve_clearance, prepare_small_features, prepare_vector_health, prepare_cutting_paths, prepare_native_vector_health.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_print_qa_services · Public sink: prepare_preflight, prepare_printcheck, prepare_curve_clearance, prepare_small_features, prepare_vector_health, prepare_cutting_paths, prepare_native_vector_health

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
